procedural_matters: SLO 3482 was represented by Pier Maria Paparella. ITA 2727 was represented by Gianluca Pilia.
facts: Wind conditions were 12 knots, and the water was choppy.
30 seconds before the starting signal, SLO 3482 was slowly drifting on the starting line, on starboard and ITA 2727 was drifting close to the RC vessel, on starboard too.
There was a 10 m lateral distance between the boats.
ITA 2727 bore away and hit SLO 3482.
Contact occurred between SLO’s 3482 starboard amidships and ITA’s 2727 bow.
There was damage: hull delamination over approximately 15 cm.
No boat took a penalty, and there was a general recall.
conclusions: ITA 2727 to windward failed to keep clear of SLO 3482 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
When it became clear that ITA 2727 was not keeping clear it was not reasonably possible for SLO 3482, the right-of- way boat to avoid contact with SLO 3482. SLO 3482 did not broke RRS 14(a).
Since the race was restarted and ITA 2727 had caused neither injury nor serious damage, she shall not be penalized as per RRS 36(b).
decision: The protest is upheld. Since the provision of RRS 36(b) applies, no penalty is imposed on ITA 2727 under RRS 60.5(c)(3).
